data.body: Plan-review passed and ticket claimed. Targeted relevant unit suites now pass: tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_corpus.py, tests/unit/test_fixture_admission.py, tests/unit/test_fixture_admission_heldout.py (34 passed).
